basic_details.job_title: IIT BHU Project Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil Engineering, IIT (BHU) Varanasi, is filling one Project Officer post for 11 months on the consultancy project "Structural Audit and Remedial Solutions for Restrengthening of Old Residential Quarters of Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW) Varanasi", at Rs. 50,000 per month (consolidated). Indian nationals with M.Tech / M.E. / M.S. in Civil / Structural Engineering, aged 35 years as on the date of the advertisement, may apply by emailing a single PDF to [email protected] within 21 days of the advertisement.

age_limit.details: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

qualification.details: Ph.D in Civil / Structural Engineering Over 01 year of industrial experience in Structural Design / Construction / Quality Control / Maintenance / Audit / Retrofitting Proficiency with software such as AutoCAD, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS, MIDAS, Tekla, ABAQUS, ANSYS etc.

how_to_apply: Download the advertisement document, which contains the application form.

Fill in the application form. It asks for personal details, academic record from Class 10 onwards, work experience, software proficiency, a declaration and an enclosure check-list; a recent passport size photograph is pasted on it.

Prepare one PDF file with these self-attested documents: the filled application form; certificates and marksheets (starting from Class 10); experience certificates (if any); a detailed resume; and one identity proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Identity Card or PAN Card).
Email the PDF file to [email protected] within 21 days of the advertisement. The notice does not give an email subject line.

Late applications shall not be considered in any case. Queries about the advertisement and application can be sent to the PI, Dr. Vishwajit Anand, at [email protected]; the notice also prints the phone number +91 – 80729 08384.
important_instructions: All documents in the single PDF must be self-attested. The application form allows extension to another page if required. Work experience in the form is listed starting with the most recent.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Project Officer at a Glance

rows.details: Structural Audit and Remedial Solutions for Restrengthening of Old Residential Quarters of Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW) Varanasi
35 Years as on date of advertisement

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals. Ph.D in Civil / Structural Engineering Over 01 year of industrial experience in Structural Design / Construction / Quality Control / Maintenance / Audit / Retrofitting Proficiency with software such as AutoCAD, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS, MIDAS, Tekla, ABAQUS, ANSYS etc. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Tech / M.E. / M.S. in Civil / Structural Engineering

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Officer receives Rs. 50,000/- per month (Consolidated) for a duration of 11 months. The candidate may be further considered based on satisfactory performance and future consultancy projects. The appointment is terminable with one month notice on either side and does not confer any right for extension and/or re-appointment. The selected candidate is expected to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Project Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist the Principal Investigator (PI) in proof-checking structural design and drawings. Assist the PI in conducting structural safety assessment studies.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates found suitable will be called for an interview at IIT (BHU) Varanasi, and the final selection will be based on interview performance. The interview will be held in physical mode. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed to appear, and communication regarding shortlisting and/or selection will not be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates called for the interview. The notice does not print an interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All documents in the single PDF must be self-attested. The application form allows extension to another page if required. Work experience in the form is listed starting with the most recent.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Officer posts are there at IIT (BHU) Varanasi?
faq.answer: There is one (01) opening for the Project Officer position in the Civil Engineering consultancy project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed within 21 days of the advertisement. The notice prints no calendar date, and late applications will not be considered in any case.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.Tech / M.E. / M.S. in Civil / Structural Engineering. A Ph.D in Civil / Structural Engineering is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years as on date of advertisement. Upper age relaxation for Female/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/Differently-Abled candidates applies as per Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Officer?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 50,000/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the advertisement, fill the application form, combine it with the self-attested documents in one PDF and email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Suitable candidates are called for a physical interview at IIT (BHU) Varanasi. Final selection is based on interview performance.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration is 11 months. It is terminable with one month notice on either side and gives no right to extension or re-appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to candidates called for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with no industrial experience apply?
faq.answer: Yes, if they meet the essential qualification and age limit. Over 01 year of industrial experience is listed only as a desirable qualification.
